brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.requirement: Shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: Build has 4 cells (0,0,0;full, 0,1,0;full, plus upper level 0,0,1 and 0,1,1 with hex-bin-full bins as shelves) with meshClash clear, but configurator explicitly does not verify structural load. Per instructions do not claim load ratings; no 50 kg rating can be verified.

Two hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf frames placed at -1,1 level 0 and level 1 (notch:0#-1,1#notch0, notch:1#-1,1#notch0). No drawer modules are installed; find_sockets for drawer returns 0 offers and no drawer refs exist in get_build. Requirement not met.

finish.summary: Build is a small 2-level hex cluster with bins as shelves, meshClash clear, but neither requirement is verifiably met: load rating cannot be certified by this tool, and drawer insertion did not succeed despite frames being placed.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
